description: Create a free, anonymous survey in the connected account and publish it (or save it as a draft with publish: false). Surveys are for feedback, not binding votes: anyone with the link can answer and respondents are not verified. For anything binding (a board election, a bylaw amendment, an assessment) use create_election_draft. Question types: single (pick one), multiple (checkboxes), yes_no, rating (1-5 by default; settings {scale: "nps"} makes a 0-10 Net Promoter Score), ranking, open_text. Returns the share link.

publish.description: Publish now (default true) or save a draft.

options.description: Required (at least 2) for single, multiple and ranking.

settings.description: Optional: minRating/maxRating/ratingLabels for rating, scale "nps", variant "short"|"email"|"number"|"date"|"phone" for open_text, allowWriteIn for single/multiple, maxSelections for multiple.
Optional: showResultsDuring, showResultsAfter, requireAllQuestions, collectEmail, collectName.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the close time. Defaults to UTC.

name: create_survey
title: Create a survey
